dataset: Codex Conditions official renal and urinary etiology B24
policy: Fill only currently empty bilingual etiology fields for five renal or urinary Conditions. Preserve existing pathology, risks, red flags, acupuncture scope, relations, and provenance; append direct government, NHS, or NCBI sources. Distinguish syndromes and structural consequences from their underlying causes, and preserve infected-obstruction and rapidly progressive renal emergency boundaries.

cond.acute_kidney_injury.etiology_zh: 急性腎損傷（AKI）是多種急性病因造成的腎功能下降，不是物理撞擊，也不是單一疾病。病因實務上分為三組但可同時存在：腎前性是有效腎灌流下降，例如脫水、出血、低血壓、敗血症、心衰竭或肝衰竭；若灌流未及時恢復，可進展為缺血性腎小管損傷。腎實質性包括缺血或腎毒性造成的 acute tubular injury、腎絲球腎炎、血管炎、急性間質性腎炎、血管栓塞／血栓、感染和 rhabdomyolysis 等。腎後性則由尿路阻塞造成，如結石、攝護腺增大、腫瘤、血塊、狹窄或神經性膀胱；單側阻塞在另一腎正常時未必使 creatinine 明顯上升。藥物可經不同路徑促成 AKI，包括改變腎小球血流、直接腎小管毒性、過敏性間質炎或結晶阻塞，不能籠統稱為同一種「腎毒」。敗血症性 AKI 也不一定只有低血壓，還涉及微循環、發炎和細胞代謝失調。評估須同時尋找低灌流、內在腎病與阻塞，因快速矯正可逆原因會影響腎恢復與生命風險。
cond.acute_kidney_injury.etiology_en: Acute kidney injury (AKI) is an abrupt loss of kidney function caused by many acute processes; it is not physical trauma and not one disease. Causes are conventionally grouped into three categories that can coexist. Prerenal AKI reflects reduced effective renal perfusion from dehydration, hemorrhage, hypotension, sepsis, heart failure, or liver failure; if perfusion is not restored, ischemic tubular injury can follow. Intrinsic AKI includes ischemic or toxic acute tubular injury, glomerulonephritis, vasculitis, acute interstitial nephritis, renal vascular occlusion, infection, and rhabdomyolysis. Postrenal AKI results from urinary obstruction such as stones, prostatic enlargement, tumor, clot, stricture, or neurogenic bladder; unilateral obstruction may not substantially raise creatinine when the other kidney functions normally. Medicines can cause AKI through distinct pathways—altered glomerular hemodynamics, direct tubular toxicity, hypersensitivity interstitial nephritis, or crystal obstruction—and should not be collapsed into one generic “nephrotoxicity.” Septic AKI is also not explained by hypotension alone; microcirculatory, inflammatory, and cellular metabolic disturbances contribute. Evaluation must concurrently consider hypoperfusion, intrinsic renal disease, and obstruction because rapid correction of reversible causes affects renal recovery and survival.

cond.glomerulonephritis.etiology_zh: 腎絲球腎炎是多種免疫性或感染相關疾病造成的腎絲球發炎與損傷總稱，不是一個單一病因。主要機轉包括：抗原—抗體免疫複合體在腎絲球沉積或原位形成（如 IgA nephropathy、lupus nephritis、感染後或感染相關 GN）；抗體直接攻擊 glomerular basement membrane 的 anti-GBM disease；以及 ANCA-associated small-vessel vasculitis 等 pauci-immune 型，切片免疫沉積很少但可快速形成新月體。感染可在感染後誘發免疫反應，也可於持續性 endocarditis、HBV、HCV 或 HIV 等背景下驅動腎炎；這不等同細菌通常直接侵入腎絲球。另有 complement dysregulation、遺傳性 Alport syndrome、某些癌症或藥物相關型態，部分病例原因仍不明。臨床的 nephritic 或 rapidly progressive syndrome 描述表現與速度，不等於已確立組織病因；血清學、補體、感染檢查與腎切片需用來區分類型，因免疫抑制若用在未控制感染可造成危害。
cond.glomerulonephritis.etiology_en: Glomerulonephritis is an umbrella term for glomerular inflammation and injury caused by diverse immune or infection-associated diseases, not a single etiology. Major mechanisms include antigen–antibody immune complexes deposited or formed in glomeruli, as in IgA nephropathy, lupus nephritis, and postinfectious or infection-related GN; antibodies directed against the glomerular basement membrane in anti-GBM disease; and pauci-immune processes such as ANCA-associated small-vessel vasculitis, which may form crescents rapidly despite little immune deposition on biopsy. Infection can trigger a postinfectious immune response or drive nephritis during persistent endocarditis, HBV, HCV, or HIV; this does not usually mean bacteria directly invade the glomerulus. Complement dysregulation, inherited Alport syndrome, selected cancers or medicines, and idiopathic forms are additional causes. A nephritic or rapidly progressive syndrome describes presentation and tempo rather than a proven tissue diagnosis. Serology, complement, infection testing, and kidney biopsy distinguish mechanisms because immunosuppression can be harmful when an active infection has not been controlled.

cond.nephrotic_syndrome.etiology_zh: 腎病症候群是 glomerular filtration barrier 嚴重失去蛋白選擇性的臨床症候群，而不是特定病理診斷。原發性腎臟原因依年齡與族群不同，包括 minimal change disease、focal segmental glomerulosclerosis（FSGS）與 membranous nephropathy；FSGS 本身也是一種損傷型態，可由遺傳、病毒、藥物、肥胖或腎單位減少等二次適應反應造成，不能把所有 FSGS 當作同一原發病。續發性原因包括糖尿病、systemic lupus erythematosus、amyloidosis、monoclonal gammopathy／myeloma、HBV、HCV、HIV、部分癌症，以及 NSAIDs 等藥物。兒童還應考慮 congenital nephrotic syndromes 與其他單基因足細胞疾病。不同病因透過 podocyte、slit diaphragm 或 glomerular basement membrane 損傷增加白蛋白通透性；大量蛋白流失繼而造成低白蛋白、水腫、高脂血症、感染與血栓風險，但這些是後果而非起始病因。年齡、臨床背景、血液與感染檢查、遺傳線索及腎切片用於確定原因，不能只憑蛋白尿量推定病理型態。
cond.nephrotic_syndrome.etiology_en: Nephrotic syndrome is a clinical syndrome of severe loss of protein selectivity across the glomerular filtration barrier, not a specific histopathologic diagnosis. Primary renal causes vary by age and population and include minimal change disease, focal segmental glomerulosclerosis (FSGS), and membranous nephropathy. FSGS itself is an injury pattern that can be primary or secondary to genetic disease, viruses, medicines, obesity, reduced nephron mass, or other adaptive stress; not every FSGS lesion is the same disease. Secondary causes include diabetes, systemic lupus erythematosus, amyloidosis, monoclonal gammopathy or myeloma, HBV, HCV, HIV, selected cancers, and medicines such as NSAIDs. Congenital nephrotic syndromes and other monogenic podocyte disorders are especially relevant in children. These causes injure podocytes, the slit diaphragm, or glomerular basement membrane and increase albumin permeability. Heavy protein loss then produces hypoalbuminemia, edema, hyperlipidemia, infection risk, and thrombosis risk, but those are consequences rather than initiating causes. Age, clinical context, blood and infection studies, genetic clues, and kidney biopsy identify the cause; protein quantity alone cannot establish the histologic type.

cond.hydronephrosis.etiology_zh: 腎盂積水描述 renal collecting system 擴張，是尿流受阻或少數非阻塞性情境造成的結構結果，不是獨立病因。阻塞可在管腔內、管壁或外部壓迫：結石、血塊或 sloughed papilla 可堵塞管腔；先天 UPJ/UVJ 狹窄、術後或發炎性輸尿管狹窄、後尿道瓣膜及腫瘤可累及管壁；攝護腺增生、骨盆或腹膜後腫瘤、retroperitoneal fibrosis 與妊娠可由下游阻塞或外壓造成。膀胱出口阻塞或 neurogenic bladder 常導致雙側影響，而單側 hydronephrosis 較常提示一側輸尿管或 UPJ 問題。膀胱輸尿管逆流、高尿流量及妊娠的生理性擴張可出現集尿系統擴張而不一定有固定機械阻塞，因此影像見 hydronephrosis 不應自動等同 obstructive nephropathy。真正持續阻塞會升高上游壓力、降低 GFR，久後造成 tubular atrophy 與 interstitial fibrosis；合併感染時為需迅速引流的泌尿急症。病因需依側別、膀胱充盈、症狀、腎功能及影像定位確認。
cond.hydronephrosis.etiology_en: Hydronephrosis describes dilatation of the renal collecting system. It is a structural consequence of impaired urine flow or selected nonobstructive states, not an etiology by itself. Obstruction may be intraluminal, mural, or extrinsic: stones, clots, or a sloughed papilla can block the lumen; congenital UPJ or UVJ narrowing, postoperative or inflammatory ureteral stricture, posterior urethral valves, and tumors can involve the wall; and prostatic enlargement, pelvic or retroperitoneal tumor, retroperitoneal fibrosis, or pregnancy can obstruct downstream or compress externally. Bladder-outlet obstruction and neurogenic bladder often produce bilateral effects, while unilateral hydronephrosis more often localizes to one ureter or UPJ. Vesicoureteral reflux, high urine flow, and physiologic pregnancy-related dilatation can enlarge the collecting system without fixed mechanical obstruction, so hydronephrosis on imaging is not automatically obstructive nephropathy. Sustained true obstruction raises upstream pressure, lowers GFR, and eventually causes tubular atrophy and interstitial fibrosis. Obstruction plus infection is a urologic emergency requiring prompt drainage. Cause is established from laterality, bladder state, symptoms, kidney function, and imaging localization.

cond.ureteral_stones.etiology_zh: 輸尿管結石多數先在腎臟由過飽和尿液中的晶體 nucleation、growth 與 aggregation 形成，再移入輸尿管；「輸尿管結石」描述位置，不代表另一種成分。低尿量使鈣、草酸、磷酸、尿酸或 cystine 濃縮，是各類結石共通促進因素。鈣草酸／磷酸結石最常見，可由 hypercalciuria、hyperoxaluria、hypocitraturia、distal renal tubular acidosis、hyperparathyroidism 或腸道吸收不良等促成；正常飲食鈣不應簡化為鈣結石的直接原因。尿酸結石主要在持續酸性尿環境形成，與 gout、metabolic syndrome、高動物性 purine 負荷或慢性腹瀉等相關。Struvite 結石由 urease-producing urinary infection 使尿液鹼化而形成；cystine 結石則源於遺傳性 cystinuria。部分藥物本身可結晶，或改變尿 pH／溶質排泄。結石進入輸尿管後在狹窄處嵌頓造成阻塞、蠕動與壓力性疼痛；疼痛劇烈度不能可靠反映石頭大小或腎損傷。合併發燒／感染與阻塞、單腎阻塞、無尿或腎功能惡化需緊急泌尿評估，而不是一般無併發症腎絞痛。
cond.ureteral_stones.etiology_en: Most ureteral stones first form in the kidney through crystal nucleation, growth, and aggregation in supersaturated urine, then migrate into the ureter; “ureteral stone” describes location rather than a separate composition. Low urine volume concentrates calcium, oxalate, phosphate, uric acid, or cystine and promotes all major stone classes. Calcium oxalate and calcium phosphate stones are most common and can be driven by hypercalciuria, hyperoxaluria, hypocitraturia, distal renal tubular acidosis, hyperparathyroidism, or intestinal malabsorption; normal dietary calcium should not be simplified as the direct cause of calcium stones. Uric acid stones form chiefly in persistently acidic urine and are associated with gout, metabolic syndrome, high animal-purine intake, or chronic diarrhea. Struvite stones arise when urease-producing urinary infection alkalinizes urine, while cystine stones result from inherited cystinuria. Selected medicines can crystallize directly or alter urine pH and solute excretion. After migration, a stone may lodge at a ureteral narrowing and cause obstruction, peristalsis, and pressure-mediated pain; pain severity does not reliably indicate stone size or kidney injury. Fever or infection with obstruction, obstruction of a solitary kidney, anuria, or worsening renal function requires urgent urologic evaluation rather than routine uncomplicated-colic care.
